title: How chronic environmental stress drives immune dysfunction in cold tumors
desc: Immunotherapy has transformed cancer treatment, yet many tumors remain stubbornly resistant to its effects. Among the most challenging are "cold tumors," including ovarian, breast and prostate cancers, which evade immune attack and respond poorly to existing immunotherapies.
